How to use StephTone 3.1

StephTone turns any image into a halftone, line, ring or pattern screen. It runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded anywhere.

0 / THE MIXER

  • StephTone 3.1 runs two complete decks: A on the left and B on the right. Each has its own image, presets, controls and undo.
  • The centre shows the output. Move the crossfader to blend from A to B. Cut A and Cut B jump to either end, and Auto Fade sweeps back and forth over 2 to 16 seconds.
  • Blend Mode sets how B is applied over A (Mix, Add, Screen, Multiply, Overlay, Difference, Exclusion), and the fader sets how much of B. Output Frame picks the shape of the mix.
  • Changes in either deck update the output live, including while you hold Generate. ⛶ Fullscreen (top-right corner of the output, or under ▾ More) fills the screen for projection. Esc exits.
  • ⇅ Top swaps which deck is the top layer (B by default). The fader still runs from A at the left to B at the right. ▾ More unfolds sweep time, output frame, background and export, and folds back so the output fills the middle.
  • Hold to Generate buttons under the output make variations for deck A, deck B or both while you hold them.
  • Scenes (under ▾ More) save deck A, deck B and the mixer settings together, so you can recall a whole mix. Built-in images are restored; images you uploaded stay as loaded.
  • Everything below applies to each deck. Click a deck to make it the active one for paste and Ctrl/Cmd+Z.

1 / LOAD AN IMAGE

  • Upload Image opens your file picker. You can also drag a file onto the page or paste with Ctrl/Cmd+V.
  • Photo, Portrait and Colour load the built-in images. Use Colour to see CMYK separations.
  • Invert, Flip and Rotate 90 adjust the image before screening.

2 / START FROM A PRESET

Open Presets (folded by default) and pick one to start from. Each preset resets everything first. Type a name and press + Save to keep your own. Reset All starts clean.

3 / USE THE KNOBS

Drag a knob up or down. Hold Shift for fine control, scroll for single steps, double-click to reset. Controls only appear when they apply to the chosen screen.

4 / THE SECTIONS

  • Screen: Unified, or H / M / S split to style highlights, mids and shadows separately. Dots (grid or hex), lines, wavy lines, rings, crosshatch, stochastic or pattern.
  • Tessellation: splits the image into Voronoi, grid or shard cells. Cell Gap, Position Offset and Rotation Variance move each cell. Random Scale scales each cell’s content by a random amount, and Random Cell Size resizes the cells themselves so every one is a different size. Both are extreme at full.
  • Tone: contrast, brightness, gamma, Hide Whites (keeps highlights as clean paper), min and max mark, sample smoothing.
  • Texture: position jitter, ink noise, misregistration between plates, seed.
  • Plates: in CMYK mode, view cyan, magenta, yellow or black alone.
  • Pattern: threshold-map screens: noise, serpentines, spirals, arcs.
  • Image Filters: grayscale method, colour filter hue, Image Width (working resolution), blur, sharpen.
  • Colour and Image Filters sit at the top of each deck. Colour: Mono, Duo, Tri or CMYK, with a Standard or SLV swatch set (Ultramarine, Riso Pink, Fluoro Orange, Jet Black, Cyan Halftone, White). Transparent Paper removes the paper colour so only the ink shows. That lets a deck sit over the other in the mix, and PNG exports keep the transparency when the output background is set to Transparent. Choose inks and paper from the swatches or a custom colour. Swap Ink / Paper inverts them.

5 / EXPLORE AND UNDO

  • Undo and Redo sit under each deck’s preview (Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Shift+Z). They cover settings, not which image is loaded.
  • ● Hold to Generate (under the output, for A, B or both): hold to keep producing variations (seed, jitter, noise, angle, cell sizes). Let go to stop. The result is one undo step.
  • Everything starts folded except the image upload bar. Every section is collapsible: click a section heading to fold it, Fold All and Open All do the whole deck, and the coloured deck header collapses the deck. The blocks under the output fold the same way.
  • Press F for Clean View (hides both decks), and ? to open this help.

6 / EXPORT (THE MIX)

The export controls under the output save the mixed result at the current fader position.

  • PNG: 1×, 2×, 3×, 4× HR or 6× HR, with a 72, 150 or 300 DPI tag. The status line shows the pixel and print size. Very large exports are capped by browser limits.
  • SVG: true vector with one named layer per ink. Paper Background adds or removes the paper layer. Turn Multiply Plates off if your design app ignores blend modes.

TIPS

  • To stay close to your photo, use a small cell size, low Tessellation and Hide Whites around 6–10.
  • For a print look, use Duo, Tri or CMYK with some misregistration, a warm paper colour and a little ink noise.
  • If the preview lags, use a larger cell size while you adjust and reduce it at the end.
